note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the .do keeps the REG08A column names P801-P804 verbatim as item (gen item = "`var'"; core model s3 pattern 1, no rename), and those names are the questionnaire's own question numbers 801-804, confirmed by the data dictionary (Variable column P801..P804 against Pregunta 801..804 and their question labels), 4/4. RESP: the .do sets 8 (No sabe o no recuerda / No recuerda) and 9 (NR) to missing and recodes (3=1)(1=2)(2=3), so the source order 1 De vez en cuando, 2 Con mucha frecuencia, 3 Nunca (questionnaire and dictionary agree) becomes live 1=Nunca, 2=De vez en cuando, 3=Con mucha frecuencia, and option_text is keyed to the live codes. Route 9: raw REG08A counts for source codes 3/1/2 equal live resp 1/2/3 counts in 12/12 cells: P801 2667/325/243, P802 2100/770/367, P803 1953/1097/217, P804 2200/814/243; the unrecoded reading fails (P801 raw 1/2/3 = 325/243/2667). Dropped: code 8 on P801 40, P802 39, P803 8, P804 18; code 9 one each on P801, P803, P804. Live 12996 rows, 3275 ids; per-item n 3235/3237/3267/3257. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (4 items, resp {1,2,3}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = the questionnaire's printed questions 801-804 verbatim, including the 'Ejemplo: ...' clause printed with 801 and 803; line-break hyphens joined (802 'insulta-ban', 804 'la insulta-ban'); 803's 'puño,patadas' (no space) kept as printed. The manual reproduces the same stems except 804, which it prints as 'la insultaban o la ofendían a usted' without 'le gritaban'; the questionnaire form ships. The data dictionary's labels were NOT used for text: they move the example into a parenthesis ('(puño, patadas, bofetadas o con objetos como cintos, etc..)') and misprint P802 as 'se defendían' for 'se ofendían'. instructions = the section's read-aloud framing ('Ahora le voy a hacer unas preguntas de cuando usted era niña; ... hasta antes de cumplir 18 años de edad.') without the interviewer direction 'ENCUESTADORA, léale lo siguiente a la entrevistada:' and the quotation marks. option_text = the questionnaire's category labels verbatim (Nunca / De vez en cuando / Con mucha frecuencia); no row for the dropped 8/9 codes. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INE publishes the ENSIMUP in Spanish only; English produced by IRW ('de vez en cuando' rendered 'now and then', 'con mucha frecuencia' 'very often', 'cintos' 'belts'). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('How often adults in her childhood home hit or insulted each other, and hit or insulted her') and the .do comment match Sección VIII exactly; 4 live items = 4 questions, 3-level resp = the three substantive categories. RIGHTS: originator INE Paraguay; the questionnaire and manual cite no upstream instrument for Sección VIII (the manual cites INEGI's ENDIREH 2016 marco conceptual only for definitions in its concepts chapter; INEGI carries a ship verdict in instrument_rights_register.csv in any case). public_note: The English wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by INE Paraguay, which publishes the ENSIMUP 2021 in Spanish only; the response codes were reordered in processing so that 1 = Nunca (never), 2 = De vez en cuando (now and then), 3 = Con mucha frecuencia (very often), unlike the questionnaire's own 1 = De vez en cuando, 2 = Con mucha frecuencia, 3 = Nunca, and 'don't know/don't remember' answers are recoded to missing.
